[media]
# A new era begins… and your legend is waiting to be forged 🐒⚔️

Enter a vibrant medieval world where every player starts as a **monkey**—and rises through powerful evolutions to become a **Caveman**, a **Viking**, and ultimately a **Knight**. Each step forward unlocks **new identity, new power, and new ways to stand out.**

At the center of it all is the **Medieval Villa 🏰**—a living hub where players gather, prepare, and show off their progress. Customize your house, unlock perks, and build your presence as you climb toward greatness.

# 🐾 RAISE YOUR PET ARMY
Collect Wolves 🐺, Bears 🐻, Tigers 🐯, and Dragons 🐉—each one ready to grow alongside you. Strengthen them by exploring three distinct worlds:

🌿 **Valley** – Begin your journey and gather essential resources  
❄️ **Ice Mountain** – Face tougher enemies and harsher conditions  
🌋 **Volcano** – Conquer extreme challenges to unlock peak power  

Feed your pets, level them up, and turn them into unstoppable companions.

[media]

# ⚔️ EVOLVE YOUR HERO
From primal beginnings to armored mastery, each evolution transforms how you look, feel, and play. Stand out in the Villa and on the battlefield.

This isn’t just a race—it’s **your journey of evolution, power, and prestige.**

👉 Enter the medieval world, grow your army, and rise to legend and don't miss the #wild-talk in our Discord channel >> **https://discord.com/invite/etermaxrstudio*
